identity.title: [v0.92][WP-01][readiness] Complete design-time cards for every milestone issue

values.review_scope: All 58 execution-readiness packets, the canonical dependency and sprint graph, exact ownership and serialization, pinned live and artifact manifests, typed doctor evidence, the #5860 matrix, explicit #5861 exclusion, and the no-product-diff boundary.
review_prompts: Can every child bind after only just-in-time claim reacquisition?
Are all designs and plans issue-specific and source-grounded?
Do VPPs name real proving and negative lanes without claiming execution?
Are SRP/SOR and all non-claims truthful?
